tests.title: Companion on the shop's dLive (DM0 + C3500, 2.12): the re-check rows — from source, about 3 min (almost all of it over HTTP)
tests.answers: the module thread; the checklist's dLive re-check row: 'The Companion module after 550c3ba and #342's fix: scene_current on connect, stereo variables'
tests.expect: connected true; the cold state as DMA TEST; scene_current reads the loaded scene on a FRESH CONNECT (#342); the stereo variables read '' where the desk cannot say and never false (550c3ba) — a dLive can never report an input's link, so linked_ch11 and partner_ch11 EMPTY is the expected pass here, and width_ch11 too unless this desk reports a width; every write lands; a recall by place is what a dLive gets
tests.record: the module's SHA; every variable read, with its value; the connection status string; MIDI Bridge's log over the block (writes, echoes, scene events with number and name, and the 400s); Companion's log for the dylanmaudio connection
tests.safety: Every write is on SAFE9 (Input 9: no source patched, no output patched, no main assign) or is a scene recall of DMA TEST's own scenes. Nothing in DMA TEST is patched to an output and no main assign is on, so no write reaches audio on any of these desks. The block ends by recalling BASE, which puts SAFE9 and Input 8 back as found. The module never writes a level to a desk whose dB law MIDI Bridge has not measured: it refuses and says so.

steps.prompt: Page 11 'Shop check' must be imported into Companion ONCE before the first desk (not per desk): Companion -> Buttons -> Import, choose blocks/shop-check.companionconfig from the module repo, and put it on page 11. It carries 14 buttons: row 0 SAFE9's fader and mute, row 1 scenes by place, row 2 scenes by number (including list B and a list the desk hasn't got). It references the existing dylanmaudio connection by id, so the import should map it with nothing to choose. If page 11 is taken, import it anywhere and change the page number in every curl below. Row 0's 'MUTE off' button carries NO feedback: until 4 Nov it carried the same mute feedback as 'MUTE on', so both lit red whenever ch 9 was muted (seen on the Quantum). A page imported before that fix shows the old look -- cosmetic, and it must not fail the mute ask, which is about 'MUTE on'.

steps.text: CLAUDE, the build (nothing is sent). Companion runs this module from source through a dev-module symlink — /Users/dylanmitrovich/companion-dev-modules/dylanmaudio -> /Users/dylanmitrovich/Documents/GitHub/companion-module-dylanmaudio — and the connection's moduleVersionId is "dev", so whatever is in the repo's dist/ IS the module. Check all three: (a) git -C "/Users/dylanmitrovich/Documents/GitHub/companion-module-dylanmaudio" rev-parse --short HEAD  → wants 69635f4 or any later commit on topic/avantis-yamaha, and RECORD what it reads; 69635f4 is the last commit that changed src/, so a later HEAD is docs or these blocks and changes no behaviour; (b) git -C "/Users/dylanmitrovich/Documents/GitHub/companion-module-dylanmaudio" status --short  → wants empty (an uncommitted change means dist/ and the SHA do not describe each other); (c) find "/Users/dylanmitrovich/Documents/GitHub/companion-module-dylanmaudio/dist" -name '*.js' -newer "/Users/dylanmitrovich/Documents/GitHub/companion-module-dylanmaudio/src/bridge/bridgelink.ts" | head -1  → wants a line (dist newer than src; if empty, run corepack yarn build in that checkout and nothing else). There is no package to import and no version to bump: 1.1.93 is the version on every build of this line, so the SHA is the identity. Record the SHA, not the version.

CLAUDE, the desk and the gate (nothing is sent). curl -s 127.0.0.1:8765/api/v1/info and read the console block. Wants: it names the dLive; verified_on_desk true (V applied in A — if it is false the look still RUNS, read-only: every write is refused with the module's own sentence, and that refusal is itself a pass for this step, recorded as 'gate shut'). A dLive's block carries no verified_on_desk at all and that is correct: absence means verified on the dLive and not yet on anything else, so the module gates on driver == 'dlive' OR verified_on_desk true. A dLive must never read as gated. NEW TODAY, and worth knowing if V is applied mid-session: the module re-reads this block from the bridge's SSE `console` event, so a desk that becomes verified while Companion is connected starts being driven WITHOUT a reconnect. Before today it would have refused for the rest of the session.

CLAUDE, the connection's own words (nothing is sent): curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/connections | python3 -m json.tool — the dylanmaudio row's status. Wants category "ok" on a verified desk. On an unverified one it reads "MIDI Bridge is driving a <desk>; this module version drives a dLive only": copy it word for word, it is the evidence for 'gate shut'. This is the same sentence the operator would read on Companion's Connections tab, so nobody has to look at the screen for it.

CLAUDE, the cold state, read over HTTP (nothing is sent). Run: curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/variable/dylanmaudio/name_ch1/value; curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/variable/dylanmaudio/name_ch8/value; curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/variable/dylanmaudio/fader_ch1/value; curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/variable/dylanmaudio/fader_ch5/value; curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/variable/dylanmaudio/mute_ch8/value; curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/variable/dylanmaudio/linked_ch11/value; curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/variable/dylanmaudio/partner_ch11/value; curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/variable/dylanmaudio/width_ch11/value; curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/variable/dylanmaudio/scene_current/value; curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/variable/dylanmaudio/scene_current_name/value; curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/variable/dylanmaudio/connected/value; curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/variable/dylanmaudio/gets_missed/value; curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/variable/dylanmaudio/unsupported_gets/value; Against DMA TEST (prepared-show-spec §Must 2, 6, 8, 11, 13): name_ch1 ZEBRA1, name_ch8 NARWHAL8, fader_ch1 "0.0", fader_ch5 "-20.0", mute_ch8 true, scene_current 1 (the show is stored with Scene 1 last, so it loads at BASE), connected true. scene_current_name is EXPECTED EMPTY on every desk here: the module only knows scene names from an imported dLive show file, and it does not read the bridge's scene list yet (audit §4 item 4) — empty is a pass, not a fail. linked_ch11 / partner_ch11 / width_ch11 are the stereo pair: whichever of the two forms the desk reports, and EMPTY where the desk cannot say — empty is the right answer there, never false (550c3ba). On a dLive the fader variables come from our own measured table where the desk sends no dB, so fader_lv_ch1 is worth reading too.

CLAUDE, the writes, over HTTP. SAFE9 (Input 9) has no source and no output patched and every main assign is off, so none of this reaches audio. In order, 2 s apart: curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/location/11/0/0/press (SAFE9 -20 dB); curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/location/11/0/1/press (0 dB); curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/location/11/0/3/press (MUTE on); curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/location/11/0/4/press (MUTE off); curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/location/11/0/2/press (-inf, SAFE9 as found). After each, read it back: curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/variable/dylanmaudio/fader_ch9/value and curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/variable/dylanmaudio/mute_ch9/value. No fader_db gate here: the dLive is not a foreign family, so the module converts dB to a dLive lv itself and the three fader presses MUST land. A refusal is a real fail -- the Quantum's expected refusal on 4 Nov came from capabilities.fader_db false, which cannot arise on the dLive. Then the scene, by PLACE: curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/location/11/1/1/press (place 2, ALLZERO). ALLZERO moves seven faders and unmutes Input 8, so the proof of the recall is scene_current: curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/variable/dylanmaudio/scene_current/value → 2. Read it, but know what it proves: this desk COUNTS its scenes, so the module applies the place it just sent without waiting for the desk (localEvent) — scene_current goes to 2 whether or not the desk moved. It proves the press ran and reached the bridge. The desk's own word is the scene event in MIDI Bridge's log, so on this desk that log is the proof and the variable is the corroboration. Then, for the channels, RECORD curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/variable/dylanmaudio/fader_ch2/value and curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/variable/dylanmaudio/mute_ch8/value rather than failing on them. And here is the answer, measured on 4 Nov and no longer a question: EXPECT NO CHANGE. A dLive tells its sender nothing of its own write, so our recall is echoed to nobody — curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/variable/dylanmaudio/fader_ch2/value read −∞ 3 s after the place-2 recall at 16:33:33 (stale, the value from before), and only became +9.9 after the reconnect's cold sync re-read it. The bridge's own scene.current stayed 3 through all of it, which is #413 (an app's recall leaves it stale) and the bridge's, not the module's. So record the two reads and expect them to be stale, not right: on this desk the recall's values exist in no mirror until something asks again, and the Resync action is what asks. The press endpoint is POST and answers 204 whether or not a button is there (checked against this Mac's Companion, 3 Nov: POST /api/location/99/9/9/press → 204, GET → 404), so a 204 proves NOTHING. The proof of every press is the variable read-back above and MIDI Bridge's log.

CLAUDE, #342: the loaded scene on CONNECT, not after a recall. Companion keeps the last value it was given across a disconnect, so reading scene_current while the link is down proves nothing — the test has to be a fresh connect with the desk NOT on scene 1. So: recall ALLZERO first (curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/location/11/1/1/press), confirm curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/variable/dylanmaudio/scene_current/value reads 2, then make the module reconnect. The two ways of reconnecting are NOT equivalent, and only one of them tests this (found 5 Nov, in the module's code): the operator TOGGLES the dylanmaudio connection off and on in Companion's Connections tab (about 5 seconds). That destroys the module's instance and builds a new one, so its ConsoleState starts empty and scene_current can only come from the snapshot. Restarting MIDI Bridge does NOT do that: in bridge mode the module never clears its state on a reconnect — nothing calls state.reset(), and refetchState only APPLIES what the new snapshot carries — so the module still remembers the 2 it had and the read would pass against a completely empty bridge mirror. Use the toggle. Then, BEFORE pressing anything: curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/variable/dylanmaudio/scene_current/value must read 2 again — read out of the bridge's cold snapshot at GET /api/v1/state. 0, blank, or 1 is #342 unfixed. A MIDI Bridge restart is still worth doing as its OWN check, and record it as that: it shows the lane re-hellos, the connection row goes Connecting then OK, and no variable is destroyed by a reconnect. It says nothing about the snapshot. Then CLAUDE puts the desk back: curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/location/11/1/0/press (BASE — place 1), then the proof is curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/variable/dylanmaudio/scene_current/value → 1, and RECORD curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/variable/dylanmaudio/fader_ch2/value and curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/variable/dylanmaudio/mute_ch8/value without failing on them, as above. BASE also puts SAFE9 back, whatever the writes above left it at.

steps.question: On Companion's Connections tab, the dylanmaudio row is green/OK (not Connecting or an error)?
Press page 11's 'SAFE9 MUTE on' button: does that button go red while SAFE9 is muted, and back when you press 'MUTE off'?

steps.prompt: CO: the module's SHA; every variable read above with its value; the connection status string word for word; MIDI Bridge's log over the block (each write, each echo, each scene event with its number and name, and the refusal of 9.99 -- which is in COMPANION's log, not the bridge's: the bridge refuses a number not in the list before it touches the desk, so there is no TX, and the module's line reads "Bridge rejected scene: desk_state (...)" (or scene_unavailable if the snapshot list is still being read). Grep Companion's log for "Bridge rejected"); and Companion's own log for the dylanmaudio connection over the block (Settings -> Log, or ~/Library/Logs/companion). Anything the operator said.
